definitions.meaning: To set hopes on, trust in

quotations.old_english: Wá þám þe on God ne behyht
quotations.latin: vae qui non sunt confisi super sanctum Israel

source_text: be-hyhtan; p. te To set hopes on, trust in:--Wá þám þe on God ne behyht vae qui non sunt confisi super sanctum Israel, Wlfst. 48, 8.
